title: Exotic Smoky Middle Eastern Eggs Shakshuka
description: A jammy and silky Middle Eastern dish featuring cinnamon and smoky flavors, perfect for meal prep and nut-free friendly, cooked in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika, ground cinnamon, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes and stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Create 6 wells in the tomato mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
